title: Gold Skulltulas
subtitle: 100 tokens · rewards at the House of Skulltula

items.title: Third-floor alcove
items.hint: Hop across the stone platforms on the third floor toward the next room. The golden spider is on the wall of the little alcove with a chest in it.

items.title: Basement vine wall
items.hint: After the drop into the basement water room, swim to the vine-covered wall and look up. Shoot it down, then climb the vines to pick up the token.

items.title: Web-covered grate
items.hint: Swim along the basement to the barred gate draped in webs. The spider sits on the bars — a seed from the slingshot knocks it loose.

items.title: Torch-room vines
items.hint: Past the burned webs, a regular skulltula guards a vine wall in the cave. Clear it first, climb up, and take the golden one waiting above.

items.title: Behind the Know-It-All Brothers' house
items.hint: At night, check the back wall of the Know-It-All Brothers' house. It only shows up after dark.

items.title: Soft soil by the shop
items.hint: Drop a bottled bug onto the patch of soft soil beside the Kokiri Shop and a golden spider crawls out.

items.title: Roof of the House of Twins
items.hint: As an adult at night, the spider is on top of the twins' house. Pull it down with the hookshot.

items.title: Soft soil by the bridge
items.hint: From the Kokiri Forest entrance, take two lefts and duck under the bridge to a soft-soil patch. Release a bug there.

items.title: Soft soil in the scrub clearing
items.hint: Deep in the woods, in the clearing with two Business Scrubs, a soft-soil patch hides another one. A bottled bug flushes it out.

items.title: Bean-plant ledge
items.hint: As a child, plant a magic bean in the soft soil by the second Business Scrub. Come back as an adult, ride the sprout up, and grab the spider on the high ledge.

items.title: High wall above the maze
items.hint: Climb onto the top of the maze walls in the Sacred Grove. The spider is on the high wall at the far end — reach it from above.

items.title: Tree by the Lon Lon Ranch gate
items.hint: Roll into the lone tree just outside the ranch gate. Something golden drops out of the branches.

items.title: Stone circle grotto
items.hint: West of the field, near the road to Gerudo Valley, a ring of stones hides a hole. Bomb the ground inside the circle and drop in at night.

items.title: Hollow by the Castle Town tree
items.hint: Bomb the base of the lone tree east of the Castle Town entrance to open a hole. The spider is down inside — a boomerang or hookshot pulls the token up.

items.title: Window of the house by the stable
items.hint: At night, look at the window of the house next to the stable. The spider is clinging to the wall there.

items.title: Wall by the stone tower
items.hint: In the east part of the corral, the spider is on the wall by the tall stone tower. A slingshot seed brings it down.

items.title: Behind the corral shed
items.hint: Walk around behind the shed at the back of the corral. The spider is on the wall there after dark.

items.title: Crate in the guardhouse
items.hint: Inside the guardhouse near the market entrance, smash the wooden crate in the corner. The spider is hiding inside it.

items.title: Tree on the castle path
items.hint: Roll into the tree by the entrance of the path up to the castle. The spider drops out of the branches.

items.title: Song of Storms grotto
items.hint: In the castle grounds, near the moat where you first woke Talon, play the Song of Storms by the tree to open a hole in the ground. Drop in for the spider.
items.remakeNote: You learn the Song of Storms as an adult in the Kakariko windmill, then come back here as a child.

items.title: Arch by the lava pit
items.hint: Near the edge of the lava pit, behind the stone arch, the spider waits on the wall. A longshot pulls the token to you.

items.title: Tree at the village entrance
items.hint: Roll into the big tree right by the village entrance. The spider falls out of the branches.

items.title: Wall of the unfinished house
items.hint: On the construction plot, the spider is on the back wall of the house nearest the Death Mountain Trail gate.

items.title: Ladder to the lookout tower
items.hint: At night, the spider is on the ladder leading up to the lookout tower. A slingshot seed knocks it down.

items.title: Below the Skulltula House window
items.hint: Under the window of the House of Skulltula itself — the stone house with the blue door — a spider clings to the wall at night.

items.title: Pile of bricks on the building plot
items.hint: On the empty plot under construction, the spider is on the stack of bricks. Check it after dark.

items.title: Roof of Impa's house
items.hint: As an adult at night, the spider is on the roof of Impa's house, next to the cucco pen. Hookshot it down.

items.title: Soft soil in the graveyard
items.hint: Release a bottled bug onto the soft-soil patch in the graveyard and the spider crawls out.

items.title: Wall by the second row of graves
items.hint: At night, check the wall to the right of the second row of graves. The spider is up on the stonework.

items.title: Soft soil by Dodongo's Cavern
items.hint: A soft-soil patch sits by the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern. A bottled bug draws the spider out.

items.title: Bombable wall past the entrance
items.hint: Just past the trail entrance, bomb the cracked wall to open a small cave. The spider is inside, out at night.

items.title: Behind the rock in the eruption area
items.hint: Higher up the trail where rocks rain down, a spider hides behind a boulder. Clear the rock and grab it after dark.

items.title: Ledge above Dodongo's Cavern
items.hint: On the ledge above the cavern entrance, behind another rock, the last trail spider waits. Night only.

items.title: Crate in the bombed room
items.hint: Bomb open the boulder-blocked room on the lower floor. In the far right corner, a crate hides the spider.

items.title: Back of the hanging platform
items.hint: Walk the ropes out to the hanging platform on the top floor. The spider is on the back of it — hookshot it from the platform.

items.title: Crate just inside the crater
items.hint: Just inside the crater entrance, smash the crate. The spider is hiding in it.

items.title: Soft soil by the Fire Temple
items.needs: Bolero of Fire, Bottle with a bug
items.hint: Warp in with the Bolero of Fire and drop a bug on the soft-soil patch near the Fire Temple entrance. The spider comes out.
items.remakeNote: The heat drains your health while you are in the crater, so come in full.

items.title: Tree at the river entrance
items.hint: Roll into the tree at the entrance to the river. The spider drops from the branches.

items.title: Ladder at the waterfall base
items.hint: At night, the spider is on the ladder at the base of the waterfall. A slingshot seed brings it down.

items.title: Ledge between the tall walls
items.hint: On the west side of the river, a narrow stretch runs between two tall walls. Climb onto the ledge on the east side of those walls, then up the ladder at its end — the spider is on the wall near the ladder.

items.title: Wall facing the Domain waterfall
items.hint: Stand in front of the waterfall that leads to Zora's Domain, then turn around. The spider is on the wall up ahead.

items.title: Left of the frozen waterfall
items.hint: As an adult, the waterfall is frozen. The spider is on the wall to the left of the top of the frozen fall.

items.title: Tree by the bombable wall
items.hint: Roll into the tree by the cracked wall in the fountain area. The spider falls out.

items.title: Wall by the southeast log
items.hint: Follow the log to the southeast corner of the fountain. The spider is on the wall near the end of it.

items.title: Fairy fountain cave
items.hint: Lift the grey stone by the Great Fairy fountain entrance with the Silver Gauntlets, hammer the small rock underneath, and drop into the hole. Use the Lens of Truth to spot the hidden spiders, clear them, and climb the slope to the golden one at the top.

items.title: Soft soil by the Lakeside Lab
items.hint: Drop a bug on the soft-soil patch in front of the Lakeside Laboratory.

items.title: Small island in the lake
items.hint: At night, the spider is on a small square island near the middle of the lake. Swim out to it.

items.title: Back wall of the Lakeside Lab
items.hint: Walk around to the back wall of the laboratory. The spider is up on the wall after dark.

items.title: Crate in the lab tank
items.hint: Sink to the bottom of the laboratory pool with the Iron Boots and Zora Tunic, then roll into the crate. The spider is inside it.

items.title: Tree on the Water Temple island
items.hint: On the island where the Water Temple sits, the spider is in the tree on top. Hookshot or shoot it down at night.

items.title: Water spout by the first bridge
items.hint: At night, the spider is on the water spout beside the first bridge across the valley.

items.title: Soft soil below the second bridge
items.hint: Down by the river below the second bridge, a soft-soil patch hides a spider. Release a bug on it.

items.title: Behind the carpenter's tent
items.hint: As an adult at night, check behind the carpenter's tent in the valley. The spider is on the back of it.

items.title: On the rock arch
items.hint: The spider sits on the big rock arch spanning the valley. Hookshot it down after dark.

items.title: Rock wall above the fortress
items.hint: High on the rock wall above the fortress, a spider waits at night. Pull it down with the hookshot.

items.title: Far target in the archery range
items.hint: In the horseback archery range, the spider is on the farthest target. An arrow brings it down.

items.title: Inside the stone building
items.hint: Cross the haunted desert to the lone stone building. The spider is inside, on the wall.

items.title: Soft soil by the Spirit Temple
items.needs: Requiem of Spirit, Bottle with a bug
items.hint: Warp in with the Requiem of Spirit and drop a bug on the soft-soil patch by the temple entrance.

items.title: Tree by the empty pond
items.hint: At night, the spider is in the tree beside the dry pond at the Colossus.

items.title: Beanstalk mound
items.hint: As a child, plant a magic bean in the soil by the temple wall. As an adult, ride the sprout to the second rocky mound, where the spider waits.

items.title: Baby dodongo room
items.hint: Beyond the bombable wall, in the room with the baby dodongos on the first floor, the spider is on the wall.

items.title: Vines above the bombed stairs
items.hint: At the top of the room with the stairs you bombed, the spider is on the vines on the second floor.

items.title: Block-and-wall room
items.hint: Push the block against the bombable wall to open a new room on the first floor. The spider is inside.

items.title: Alcove above the stairs
items.hint: Set off the bombs to lower the stairs, then use the longshot to hit the spider in the alcove above them.

items.title: Scarecrow ledge
items.hint: Back in the baby dodongo room, play the Scarecrow's Song to summon the scarecrow and reach the ledge where the spider sits.

items.title: Vines in the rising-water room
items.hint: In the room where the water rises, on the first basement floor, the spider is on the vines.

items.title: Wall by the drop-down hole
items.hint: Drop down the hole into the lower room. The spider is on a wall on the first basement floor.

items.title: Wall near the first one
items.hint: Not far from the last one, on another wall on the same basement floor, a second spider waits.

items.title: Vines to the web wall
items.hint: On the first floor, climb the vines leading up to the spiderweb wall. The golden spider is on the vines.

items.title: Vines in the first room
items.hint: Right in the first room on the first floor, the spider is on the vines. Hookshot or shoot it down.

items.title: Wall by the central stairs
items.hint: In the central room on the first floor, the spider is on the wall next to the stairs.

items.title: Chest ledge in the east courtyard
items.hint: In the east courtyard, hookshot onto the front of the small chest sitting on a ledge. The spider is up there with it.

items.title: End of the west courtyard walkway
items.hint: Follow the stone walkway above the west courtyard to its end. The spider is on the wall there.

items.title: Rotating room
items.hint: In the room that can be rotated, on the second basement floor, the spider is on the wall.

items.title: Like Like room wall
items.hint: In the room with the Like Like and the floating tiles on the first floor, the spider is on the wall.

items.title: Behind the boulder-room wall
items.hint: In the room with the rolling boulders on the third floor, bomb the cracked wall. The spider is behind it.

items.title: Scarecrow room
items.hint: Play the Scarecrow's Song in the boulder room to reach a new ledge on the fourth floor. The spider is up there.

items.title: Circular rupee room
items.hint: In the large circular room on the fifth floor, the spider is on the wall near the pile of rupees.

items.title: Rooms past the totem
items.hint: From the first room of the dungeon, head through the rooms beyond the totem. The spider is on the first floor there.

items.title: Silver rupee room
items.hint: In the room with the silver rupees, the spider hides behind the icicles. Break them to reveal it.

items.title: Falling-icicle room
items.hint: In the room with the falling icicles, the compass, and a heart piece, the spider is on the wall.

items.title: Block puzzle room
items.hint: In the block puzzle room, the spider is on the wall. Clear the puzzle and it is easy to spot.

items.title: Under the cracked floor
items.hint: Bomb the cracked floor on the first floor, then spin-attack the gate to reach the spider below.

items.title: Corner of the vortex creek
items.hint: In a corner of the swirling creek on the first floor, the spider is on the wall.

items.title: North wall of the falling-platform room
items.hint: In the room with the platforms that drop away beside the waterfall, on the third floor, the spider is on the north wall.

items.title: Wall behind the boulder run
items.hint: On the first floor, where boulders roll down the slope, the spider is on the wall behind the run.

items.title: Inside the tower
items.hint: Inside the central tower on the third floor, use the longshot to reach the spider high on the wall.

items.title: Locked room, center hall
items.hint: Drain the well with the Song of Storms, then enter the locked room off the center hall on the first floor. The spider is inside.

items.title: Second locked room
items.hint: Another locked room off the same center hall holds a second spider. Bring the Lens of Truth — the way is hidden.

items.title: Like Like room
items.hint: In the room with the Like Like on the first floor, the spider is on the wall. Deal with the Like Like first.

items.title: Spinning-blade room
items.hint: In the room with the invisible spinning blade on the fourth basement floor, the spider is on the wall. The Lens of Truth shows the way.

items.title: Cell in the spike room
items.hint: In the room with the falling spikes, check the cell at the side. The spider is inside it.

items.title: Flaming-skull room
items.hint: In the room with a single flaming skull on the fourth basement floor, the spider is on the wall.

items.title: Ghost-ship room
items.hint: Where the ghost ship first appears, play the Scarecrow's Song to reach the ledge. The spider is up there.

items.title: Three flaming skulls room
items.hint: In the room with three spinning flaming skulls on the fourth basement floor, the spider is on the wall.

items.title: Grating wall
items.hint: On the first floor of the child side, the spider is on the grating wall.

items.title: Opposite the brick climbing wall
items.hint: On the first floor, across from the brick wall you climb, the spider is on the opposite wall.

items.title: Above the door before Iron Knuckle
items.hint: In the corridor just before the Iron Knuckle fight, the spider is above the doorway.

items.title: Niche in the boulder room
items.hint: In the rolling-boulder room on the first floor of the adult side, the spider hides in a wall niche.

items.title: Statue room, third floor
items.hint: In the big statue room on the third floor, play the Scarecrow's Song to reach the high ledge where the spider waits.
